leadText: Gold's Pikachu (Japanese: ゴールドのピカチュウ Gold's Pikachu) a Pokémon obtained from the future in Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys.
plainText:
Gold's Pikachu (Japanese: ゴールドのピカチュウ Gold's Pikachu) a Pokémon obtained from the future in Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys.

==History==
Pikachu originally belonged to Eusine in the future. It became a messenger sent from there by Eusine and Bill with Bill's Time Capsule. After the time travel, it ended up in 's hands when he had a battle with Falkner's . Due to its level being high and recently joining Gold's team, it was not ready to listen to him. During the battle, Pikachu gets assisted by and who also join in. Due to their teamwork, Pikachu was able to win the Gym Battle, thus earning Gold a . Since then, Pikachu became his signature Pokémon.

Pikachu participated in a Basketball Tournament where it went up against Takeo. Due to its speed and quick movements, Gold was able to win the tournament. Then, it went with Gold to Union Cave when a caused ruckus there. Pikachu fought the Lapras and managed to put up a great fight. When Gold met Whitney, she was interested in Pikachu and wanted it. As a result, she had a battle with Gold and won, taking Pikachu. She stays with Gold until he got better. While still in Whitney's possession, Pikachu watches Gold fight Black in a tournament using .

Pikachu headbutts some trees in order for berries to fall as various were getting sick. However, Pineco fell out instead. Pikachu continued to headbutt trees until it found berries which was taken by a and was returned to the group when Morty's Gengar used to prevent the Spearow from getting away. After Whitney's Miltank felt better because of the berries Miltank ate, she rewards Pikachu back to Gold along with the . Pikachu battled with Black's Gyarados in order to determine whether or not the Gyarados should be given to Gold. However, Pikachu was stopped midway by Jasmine and had her take over. When Gold and the others were in Cianwood City, Pikachu reunited with Eusine in which Eusine reveals the story about Pikachu coming from the future.

==Personality and characteristics==
Pikachu was disobedient towards Gold at first since its level was too high for Gold's standards, even though it warmed up to him. However, this changed during the battle with Falkner's Articuno as Gold's Pokémon protected it from being hurt and Pikachu finally listened to Gold.

==Moves used==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
In The Truth About The Mysterious Whirl Islands!!, Pikachu, Croconaw, and 's formed by combining their attacks.
